caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be a metal container or shaker situated centrally on a blank, off-white background. The object is hexagonal in shape with vertically oriented sides and a slightly flared base. It has a domed lid featuring a finial at its peak and multiple small perforations, suggesting it is designed for sprinkling or sifting contents. The object also has a thin, curved handle attached at the upper side, which ends in a small spiral. The shading, rendered in greyscale, provides a sense of metallic texture and highlights the reflective surfaces and contours of the container. No other objects or decorative elements are present in the composition.
title: Silver Caster
